taste:
The Roasted Vegetable Pizza combines a crisp, thin base with soft vegetables, tangy tomato and creamy mozzarella. Roasting brings out the natural sugars in the peppers, courgettes and red onions, giving the topping a caramelised sweetness rather than a meat-led flavour. Earthy vegetable notes keep that sweetness balanced, while the tomato sauce adds a sharper contrast beneath the cheese.

Served piping hot, it offers a clear contrast between the crisp crust and the tender topping. The melting mozzarella softens each mouthful without taking the focus away from the vegetables. It suits someone who wants a comforting cheese pizza with more vegetable flavour, rather than simply choosing a meat-free version of a meat topping.
